text_block_list.text:
Мэдзиро МакКуин's ultimate goal, the
grand stage
of the spring Tenno Sho, is
fast approaching.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
She wants her grandmother, the pillar of
the
Mejiro family, as well as with her
other respected
relatives, to see her
victory.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
The desire to accomplish that burns
intensely
within her.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Meanwhile, Мэдзиро Райан also decides to
compete
in the spring Tenno Sho.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
